summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and inventory reservation feature implementing atomic reservations, priority handling, idempotency, and immutability.

requirements.description: Reserve all requested SKU lines of an order together atomically, aggregating repeated SKUs before checking stock, or reserve nothing if stock is insufficient or unknown.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: An initial inventory stock and an order containing multiple lines including possible repeated SKUs
acceptance.when: The reservation is evaluated against current stock availability after aggregating repeated SKUs
acceptance.then: Either all quantities are deducted atomically from remaining stock if sufficient stock exists, or no stock is consumed and insufficient_stock is returned

requirements.description: Allocate stock to expedited orders before normal orders, preserving the original arrival order within each priority class.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A batch of orders with expedited and normal priorities competing for limited stock
acceptance.when: Orders are processed through fulfillment orchestration
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are processed before normal orders in arrival order, receiving stock allocation first

requirements.description: Ensure order IDs are unique and idempotent: only the first occurrence of an order ID is processed, and subsequent duplicate IDs are ignored entirely.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A sequence of orders containing duplicate order IDs
acceptance.when: The order list is evaluated for fulfillment
acceptance.then: The first occurrence claims the order ID and any subsequent occurrences with that ID are completely ignored without altering stock or rejections

requirements.description: Reject invalid order lines or invalid orders without modifying stock, and ensure all caller input objects and structures remain strictly unmutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Stock and orders with invalid line specifications, invalid priorities, or invalid IDs
acceptance.then: Rejections are recorded with appropriate reason codes, stock remains unaltered, and input objects are not mutated

assumptions: Stock SKU keys must be nonempty strings and quantities must be nonnegative safe integers.
Order lines must contain exact nonempty SKU strings and positive safe-integer quantities.
Order IDs must be nonempty strings; missing or non-string IDs are rejected as invalid_order with id null.
Orders with invalid priorities that have an identifiable first occurrence claim the ID and are rejected as invalid_order.
Failed reservations do not consume inventory stock.
